name: NY-22
label: Safe D

key_factors: Markets price Mannion at ~94-95% to win
Mannion is an incumbent with a large cash advantage ($1.8M vs $187K)
District leans Democratic (D+4) in a favorable environment for Democrats
No public polling, but challenger fundraising is minimal
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Mannion: a D+4 seat, incumbency, a roughly ten-to-one fundraising edge, and no outside spending against him. Prediction markets on both Kalshi and Polymarket price his win probability around 94-95%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any late surge in outside Republican spending or unexpected polling showing a single-digit race would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
First-term incumbent John Mannion defends a Syracuse-area seat that leans Democratic by about four points. He has raised $2.7 million and holds $1.8 million on hand, while Republican Kailee Buller has raised under $300,000 with minimal cash remaining. No outside groups have spent against Mannion, and no expert raters list the race as competitive.

Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both price Mannion's win chances in the mid-90s. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on the district's lean, the incumbent's financial dominance, and market pricing, all of which point to a comfortable Democratic hold.
